content: In addition to the above baselines, we also show results of different variants of our model. DAS as shown in Algorithm SECREF6 denotes our full model. DAS-EM denotes the model with only entropy minimization for semi-supervised learning (set INLINEFORM0 ). DAS-SE denotes the model with only self-ensemble bootstrapping for semi-supervised learning (set INLINEFORM1 ). FANN (feature-adaptation neural network) denotes the model without semi-supervised learning performed (set both INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 to zeros).
